category: Advanced Training, Adaptation, and Model Surgery
definition: Surgically rewriting specific facts stored in a model's weights by locating and updating the responsible MLP associations, thousands at a time with MEMIT.
details: Surgically rewriting specific facts stored in a model's weights by locating and updating the responsible MLP associations, thousands at a time with MEMIT. A scalpel where fine-tuning is a hammer, though edits can bleed into related knowledge and degrade under stress tests.

explainer.lead: Surgically rewriting specific facts stored in a model's weights by locating and updating the responsible MLP associations, thousands at a time with MEMIT. It matters as a scalpel where fine-tuning is a hammer.

tiers.eli5: Instead of retraining the whole model to fix one fact, you go straight to where that fact lives and rewrite just that part.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers locate the MLP associations responsible for a fact and update them directly. A pitfall is that edits can bleed into related knowledge and degrade under stress tests.
tiers.paperLevel: Locate and update the responsible MLP associations to rewrite facts, thousands at a time with MEMIT; limits are edit bleed into related knowledge and degradation under stress tests.

explainer.example: MEMIT rewrites thousands of specific facts in a model's weights without full fine-tuning.
